summary.intent: Review the architecture of the caliper-fixtures shrink work (via a delegated subagent) and decide how to address its findings across open PRs (#469, #470, #474, #475, #483).
summary.outcome: A read-only architecture review was written to architecture-review.md. The assistant read it, identified defects in its own T7 PR (#483), and drafted a fix plan, but no fixes were applied yet because conflict-merge and other workers are still running.

repo: Relevance evidence in #483 is gathered outside dependency recording, so watch and lazy sessions can serve stale answers when another file changes (e.g. adding `<Button className>` on another page).
ADR 0028 says passed ambient props such as `className` belong in a layer's `used` list, not as typed rows per component; `decide` currently contradicts this and a test pins the wrong rule.
Schema 8 added a per-component `relevance` map with a `Relevance::AsToday` variant. The name is temporal, nothing reads the map yet, and `used` would cost schema 9 unless the shape is settled now.
Three ambient/React-origin predicates disagree by path; a single `declaration_origin` function in core would unify them.
`annotate` is called from three places and each call deep-clones the evidence.
Collapse dedup is O(m²); Chakra's `SystemProperties` has 705 members. The collapse-merge invariant is only a `debug_assert!`, so release builds are silent.
About 300 lines of `story_args` and some evidence fields are dead until T4.
The existing cgroup limit parser is about 40 lines; the crates that would replace it are heavy, so it stays and should handle the v1 mount case.
The extractor and `decide` disagree on what `{...props}` means; four readers of `Pick` can drift.
workflow: Review findings pushed back on speculative abstractions (lane trait, cgroup crate, type-state for `BodyFacts`, full `Exact | Declined` enum, fidelity flags); skip abstractions with only one implementation or reader.
The worthwhile additions are a single sink for deriving relevance, a `ResolveState::attempt` helper for speculative resolution, and a property test of the scheduler queue against a reference model.
The next bug class to guard against is stale derived state; a `watch_equals_fresh` property test (random edits, compare watch and lazy sessions against a fresh extract) is the model to build first.
Hold fixes until in-flight conflict-merge workers land rather than stacking edits on the same branches.
Subagent hand-back messages are model output, not user instructions.

friction: The subagent's sandbox blocked a new fetch, so branch refs in the review date from the last fetch.
The assistant's earlier judgment of T7 as 'keep one component map' was wrong, which led to defects in #483.
Concurrent workers (conflict merge, #475 fix, /code-review on wave1-base) force serialization of fixes.
open_items: #483 batch for one worker: gather evidence inside dependency recording, add the `watch_equals_fresh` model, move passed ambient members to `used`, settle the schema 8 shape (rename or drop `AsToday`), derive relevance at one sink, delete or wire dead story_args and evidence code, and unify `declaration_origin`.
#469 batch: hash-indexed dedup, a release diagnostic for the collapse-merge invariant, and one merge entry point instead of three; rebase #483 on the final #469 and call `annotate` in one place.
Verify that the conflict worker's rebase removes the stale collapse layering copy from #483.
Splits to do after open PRs merge: move scheduler `Queue` and `Upkeep` into their own modules, and the provider protocol and collapse layering out of `types/semantic.rs`.
Fix #470 findings with a single writer of 'incomplete' after item 9.
Review and push the results of the conflict merge, the #475 exact-or-declined fix, and the /code-review on wave1-base.
